response.overview: Call 866-240-3377 right now for how to escalate an xfinity customer service issue and reach a customer solutions lead. Customer solutions leads responding at 866-240-3377 possess administrative tools to re-open mishandled support tickets, investigate broken service commitments, and assign designated customer advocates over the telephone.  When everyday customer support drops the ball, you do not have to keep repeating your story to agents who cannot help. Dialing 866-240-3377 puts you through to customer solutions personnel whose entire job is fixing broken service experiences. Representatives at 866-240-3377 take complete ownership of your issue until it is resolved. Reaching out to 866-240-3377 puts you in direct contact with dedicated account personnel.  Bypassing Chatbots and Navigating the Priority Voice Menu  When you call 866-240-3377, tell the automated attendant you need 'customer service escalation' or 'unresolved issue.'...
